Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherloom
Description: Inspect Glamourer designs against the current character's carried and stored equipment.
Punchline: Plan outfits from your FFXIV wardrobe.
Changelog: Pair shields and secondary tools with individual main hands. Choose the preview weapon using the eye on its gear row. Design previews start with empty gear slots and retain the camera when switching weapons. Manual and assignment application select the pair for the current job.
